description_for_human: AI Agent Cost Optimization Tool - Reduce token usage and gas costs by up to 70%. Supports GPT-4o, Claude-3.5, Gemini-1.5 and custom pricing models.
description_for_model: AgentCost Killer is a client-side AI agent cost optimization tool that analyzes agent logs and prompts to calculate token/gas costs and provide optimized versions. It helps developers reduce LLM API costs and Web3 gas expenses through intelligent text compression and optimization.
